What is the difference between an agent run and a process run? An agent run is one execution of an agent and counts towards the runs included in Free, Pro and Business. A process run is the business unit agreed in an Enterprise proposal, such as one invoice processed, and is what production automation is priced on. How does annual billing work? Pro and Business can be paid monthly or annually. Annual billing costs 10% less than twelve monthly payments: $2,149 a year for Pro and $7,549 a year for Business. Enterprise contracts are billed annually. What does Enterprise include? Enterprise includes unlimited Clarity interviews, agent runs, concurrency and invites, plus an org-wide process landscape and process maps from workshops. It also includes SSO, audit logs, priority support, a forward-deployed engineer, a proof pack and a Proof of Value. Transformation, SAP and production automation work is scoped and priced in the proposal. How does Duvo meet enterprise security requirements? Duvo holds SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001, supports GDPR requirements, and operates in line with NIS2. Enterprise adds SSO and audit logs, and Duvo does not train its own or third-party models on customer data. The SOC 2 report and certificates are available on request through the Trust Center. How does the 5x ROI guarantee work? The contracted 5x ROI guarantee covers the scope agreed in the proposal. Before you sign, the proposal defines the baseline, measurement method and window, sign-off owner, included costs and exclusions. If the measured result is below five times the total proposal price for the agreed scope, the whole contract is free. Coverage for additional applications or private infrastructure must be explicitly agreed. Can we buy Duvo through Azure Marketplace? Yes. Duvo is listed on Azure Marketplace, and purchases there follow the listed or private-offer terms. Marketplace automation plans carry an annual commitment with included runs and a stated charge for additional runs; a per-run price does not by itself mean there is no minimum commitment. How is private deployment priced? The proposal sets out the supported process and model endpoint, setup work, capacity commitment, and who owns operations and support. Dedicated infrastructure is priced as its own line. Confirm guarantee coverage in the same proposal before counting infrastructure costs or additional applications in the value calculation. Get an Enterprise proposal for your processes. Duvo agrees the process, success measure, controls and commercial model with you before any work starts. Use Duvo when your agent needs to run inside a real operating model: assigned work, durable intake, controlled tools, human decisions, and visible outcomes. Read the docs Agents and builds Ship versioned workers with prompts, AOPs, tools, connections, evaluation notes, and release history instead of one-off scripts. Runs Start, inspect, pause, resume, approve, and replay agent work from your app, backend service, or operator workflow. Queue Build intake for claims, invoices, tickets, alerts, leads, or files so agents can claim and process work at controlled concurrency. Human-in-the-loop Pause for approvals, missing context, policy decisions, or exception review without breaking the run or losing state.
